title: Follow-up after my Neon Swarm fiasco, I made a better game that's more personal and have a steam page up now, I need some feedbacks
author: Scorchyy
selftext:
Check [this](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1xnci1h/some_afterthoughts_from_getting_blasted_here/) for the original post. Basically I made a roguelite shooter called Neon Swarm a month ago and got trashed for it because it was indeed a bad game. So now I made Through the Varnish which is way more personal and I put way more work in it. I mostly used Claude for the coding as well as ChatGPT for the marketing assets.

I'm already getting some good feedback on the game along with the AI hatred as usual but I feel I progress quite a bit since the first game. Let me know what you think of it now.
